text:
sophie: Quick heads-up — Kepler dedicated rollout target: Wed 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Hoping to run a small canary (slice-3) then stagger to full slice swap over 2 hours.

sophie: Main asks: version pin (v3.2.1-hotfix), KMS key rotation check, and explicit rollback thresholds.

dan: ack. are we still pinned to the older quant build? i thought infra suggested v3.2.0 for latency reasons.

jyoti: we validated v3.2.1-hotfix on preprod yesterday, perf looks +3% p50, no added OOMs. safety regression tests passed.

noah: KMS rotation: Kepler has rotation at 02:15 UTC in their org. that's a hard no-go during our swap. can we shift our window?

sophie: good catch. options: move rollout earlier by 30m, or swap slice after rotation and keep canary pre-rotation. prefer keep canary before rotation so we have quick rollback window.

dan: timeline proposal: 01:30 canary kickoff (slice-3, 10% traffic), 01:50 check metrics, 02:00 start slice swaps for remaining slices, pause at 02:12 to wait for KMS rotation to finish, continue 02:25 finish ramp. total window 01:30-02:45.

deploybot: deploy request received from @sophie for customer kepler, environment: dedicated-prod, image: redwood/serve:v3.2.1-hotfix, strategy: staggered-slices, canary-slice: slice-3. Deployment ID: deploy-3190004321.

deploybot: preflight checks: model-compat OK, quota OK, tls cert expiry OK, kms-policy: key-rotation-schedule conflicts with planned window -> WARNING.

jyoti: we can run canary before rotation. also recommend enabling fallback routing to v3.2.0 if token error rate > 1.5% for >5m. set automatic rollback to triggered if p99 latency increases > 1000ms over baseline for 3m.

noah: confirm Kepler ops will hold rotation until 02:25 if we ask? i can ping them but prefer minimal customer coordination.

sophie: i'll ping kepler-ops. but let's define rollback policy now: 1) auto-rollback if error rate >1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency delta >1000ms for 3m. 2) manual rollback if memory OOMs observed on >2 nodes. 3) fallback route to v3.2.0 if token errors spike but overall latency OK.

dan: add note: if we pause for KMS rotation, ensure KV cache warmup is preserved. set cache TTL to 12h for this slice to avoid cold-start regressions.

jyoti: doc the exact commands in case we need fast revert:```
# rollback to pinned image
redwoodctl deploy rollback --deploy-id deploy-3190004321 --image redwood/serve:v3.2.0
# force-route to fallback pool
redwoodctl route set --customer kepler --pool fallback-v3.2.0
```

sophie: approvals needed: @dan (infra), @jyoti (ml/validation), @noah (ops). please react with :thumbsup: to approve the updated window and rollback policy.

dan: :thumbsup: approved.

jyoti: :thumbsup: good to go on validation.

noah: pinged kepler-ops — they can delay KMS rotation to 02:30 if we keep a 02:12 pause. they asked we keep a 10m buffer. I'll keep them in the loop. :white_check_mark:

sophie: thanks. final checklist before we flip: 1) deploybot preflight green (except KMS warning acknowledged) 2) ops hold confirmed 3) rollback commands in runbook 4) metric alerts set (error rate + p99).

deploybot: status update: preflight now ACCEPTED (kms warning acknowledged by participants). Scheduled at 2026-03-24T01:30:00Z. Monitor channel: #kepler-rollout.

sophie: planning to run canary at 01:30. will post a brief update at +20m and +90m. please keep pager rota alerted.

noah: I'll be on-call for the window. dan, jyoti — you available for quick triage?

dan: i'll be around 01:15-03:00 UTC.

jyoti: same. good luck team. :rocket:
